blips.name: Autodesk Plant 3D
blips.description: AutoCAD Plant 3D is a specialized 3D computer-aided design (CAD) software developed by Autodesk for designing, modeling, and documenting process plants, such as oil and gas facilities, chemical plants, water treatment systems, and food and beverage manufacturing units. It is built directly on the familiar AutoCAD platform and included as part of standard AutoCAD subscriptions.

blips.name: Autodesk Forma Build
blips.description: Forma Build (previously known as Autodesk Build) is a unified construction management and field execution platform that connects office and site teams.

blips.name: Autodesk Civil 3D
blips.description: Autodesk Civil 3D is a 3D model-based infrastructure design and documentation software built on AutoCAD, designed for civil engineers, surveyors, and urban planners.

blips.name: Autodesk Forma Model Coordination
blips.description: Autodesk Forma Model Coordination connects teams with coordination reviews, automated clash detection, and issue management across integrated tools.

blips.name: Komatsu Intelligent Machine Control
blips.description: Komatsu Intelligent Machine Control (iMC) is a factory-integrated 3D GPS/GNSS and semi-automatic machine control technology for construction and earthmoving equipment like dozers and excavators.

blips.name: Morta
blips.description: Morta is a connected project controls and information platform for the construction, infrastructure, and AEC (architecture, engineering, and construction) industries.

blips.name: Trimble SiteVision
blips.description: Trimble SiteVision is an outdoor, real-time augmented reality (AR) and spatial data visualization system designed for construction, engineering, and utility industries. It allows field teams to overlay 2D and 3D digital design models onto the physical world at a 1:1 scale.

blips.name: Leica iCON (Captivate)
blips.description: Leica iCON field for Building Construction is tailored for the many tasks and projects Construction Professionals undertake everyday, without the need to be experienced measurement specialists. Leica iCON enables users to layout complex designs directly from reliable design data without disruption to existing processes or without requiring the user to be an experienced measurement specialist.

blips.name: Forma Site Design
blips.description: Forma Site Design (formerly known as Autodesk Forma and originally developed by Spacemaker) is a cloud-based, AI-powered software platform built for early-stage urban planning, conceptual design, and site analysis.

blips.name: OpenSpaceAI
blips.description: OpenSpace (Open Space Labs, Inc.) is an AI-powered visual intelligence and jobsite documentation platform for builders, general contractors, trades, and project owners.

blips.name: Project Workbook
blips.description: BMS 02-08 Reviews sets out how we assure project performance and demonstrate compliance with the standards to which our business is certified. By digitising this process through the Project Workbook in Morta, QES Reviews become more consistent, visible and actionable — bringing health and safety, CDM and environmental considerations together in one trusted place. More than a compliance tool, the workbook turns project information into reusable insight, helping teams learn from previous experience, manage risk earlier and make better-informed decisions.
